description: bigville R22 / newspaper-writer Rung C (block 295000): the publisher HOLDS what he is told or witnessed as a general belief. hold_told: a Fact the publisher `received` (delivered by a reporter, Rung B) becomes a held belief (pub `knows` f) with testimony provenance. hold_witnessed: a Fact the publisher saw directly (pub `witnessed_fact` f) becomes a held belief with witness provenance. Testimony-bound and anti-confabulation are STRUCTURAL: `knows` is minted ONLY from `received` or `witnessed_fact` -- no rule mints knowledge from nothing, so the publisher's held set is exactly (told) union (witnessed) and never a fact he was not given.

rules.name: hold_told
rules.comment: A Fact the publisher was TOLD (received via a reporter's delivery) becomes a held belief: pub `knows` f, provenance = testimony. Guarded by Not-already-known so it fires once.

rules.name: hold_witnessed
rules.comment: A Fact the publisher WITNESSED directly (pub `witnessed_fact` f) becomes a held belief: pub `knows` f, provenance = witness. He can know things he saw himself, not only things he was told.
